notFormalized.title: Theorem 15.3.9: the boundary hypothesis does not depend on the extension
notFormalized.label: §15.3, Theorem 15.3.9, p. 698 (2017: Theorem 15.5)
notFormalized.book: $T_{(f|\partial X, \Lambda)}$ is surjective with respect to the intersections of local faces at the support points on $\partial X$.
notFormalized.instead: `IsBoundaryFaceOnto` asks the condition for every sc⁺ extension of $\Lambda$ (V15.32). Missing: (a) $(f - s_i)'(x)$ restricted to $T^R_xX$ depends only on $s_i$ on the faces through $x$ (a germ argument in a tame chart, about 80 lines); (b) two sc⁺ extensions have local representations whose branches agree on the faces up to reindexing, a representation-independence statement on faces of the kind of Theorem 15.1.1, with branch crossing and the chart plumbing of `BoundarySymmetricStructure` (170–320 lines). Estimate 250–400 lines.

notFormalized.title: $[0,1] \times X$ admits sc-smooth partitions of unity
notFormalized.label: §15.3, proof of Corollary 15.3.10 (3), p. 699 (2017: Corollary 15.1)
notFormalized.book: $[0,1] \times X$ is a tame ep-groupoid to which Theorem 15.3.9 applies.
notFormalized.instead: `hPUC` is a hypothesis of `corollary_15_3_10_3_ty` and `corollary_15_3_10_3_glue_hyp` (V15.34). Proved (Part III wave 5): paracompactness of $|[0,1] \times X|$ (`hasParacompactOrbitSpace_cubeProd`), tameness (from $d_X \equiv 0$, V15.40), witnesses of all cylinder hypotheses on $\mathbb R^n$ (`corollary_15_3_10_3_boundary_witness`, `corollary_15_3_10_3_glue_witness`), and `hPUC` for $[0,1] \times \mathbb R^n$ (`admitsScPartitionsOfUnity_cube_rn`). Missing in general: either the product of an approximation-property atlas of $X$ (Theorem 5.5.10) with the cube charts (the approximating maps uniform in $t$ up to the corners), or a direct product construction $\sum_{i,j}\beta_i(t)\gamma_j(x)$ from partitions of unity of $[0,1]$ and $X$ subordinate to a product refinement (every open cover of $[0,1] \times X$ is refined by products, through the paracompact $|X|$ and the compact $[0,1]$, plus functoriality). Estimate 200–300 lines. The corollary does not state sc-smooth partitions of unity on $X$; this is also an added hypothesis on $X$.
